data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 24.8 million, (2013: GBP 15.6 million), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2013.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a GBP 24.8 million release from prior year gross claims reserves in 2014, representing a 19.04% reduction of the opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development contributed to the overall calendar year profit. The Active Underwriter's report specifically noted that the profit largely came from reserve releases from 2012 and prior years, and that the 2012 year of account's position improved during 2014.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable movements during the year of GBP 24.8 million
reserve releases from 2012 and prior years
data.data_quality_notes: The specific years affected for prior year development are inferred from the narrative '2012 and prior years'. No claims development triangle was found in the report.
